name: Asteroid Belt
description: Lumpy rocks crowd a broad arc across the sheet, big boulders along its middle and grit and pebbles thinning out to either side.

code.style: --rule: ( --w: @calc(max(0, 1 - abs(sqrt((((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 0.2) ^ 2 + (((@y - 0.5) / @Y) - 1.2) ^ 2) - 0.92 + @rn(-0.07, 0.07)) / 0.26)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); clip-path: @shape(split: 9; r: 0.8 + 0.13 * sin(3t + @r(0, 6.28)) + 0.07 * sin(5t + @r(0, 6.28))); mask: linear-gradient(45deg, #000 30%, #00000099 100%); transform: translate(@r(-24%, 24%), @r(-24%, 24%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)) scale(calc(0.14 + 1.15 * @var(--w) * @r(0.6, 1.1))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 32%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); clip-path: @shape(split: 9; r: 0.8 + 0.13 * sin(3t + @r(0, 6.28)) + 0.07 * sin(5t + @r(0, 6.28))); transform: translate(@r(-125%, 125%), @r(-125%, 125%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)) scale(calc(0.3 + 1.1 * @var(--w) * @r(0.3, 1))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
